description: Source code for handling user-defined diff drivers in a version control system, including pattern matching, driver registration, and configuration parsing.

methods.name: userdiff_config
methods.description: Parses and applies user diff driver configuration settings.

methods.name: userdiff_find_by_name
methods.description: Finds a userdiff driver by its name.

methods.name: userdiff_find_by_path
methods.description: Determines the diff driver to use for a given file path based on attributes.

methods.name: userdiff_get_textconv
methods.description: Retrieves the text conversion function for a diff driver, with caching.

methods.name: for_each_userdiff_driver
methods.description: Iterates over all registered userdiff drivers, both custom and built-in.
